lines.text: The LORD lays waste the earth and scatters its inhabitants, priest and people alike.
The people have broken the everlasting covenant, so a curse consumes the earth and only a few survive.
On the earth and among the nations, it will be like a harvested fig tree and leftover grapes.
The earth staggers like a soldier and sways like a shack, weighed down by its rebellion.
The LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders with great glory.
